lessons.claim: C_D = 24/Re is exactly the same thing as F=3 pi mu d v (confirmed by execution, relative difference 0). ★ The discipline [W]'s worked example uses is the same as our health gate -- 'solve assuming Stokes' law holds, then check the Reynolds number to verify its use'. The Stokes validity range is Re<~1 (regime 1, creeping flow). Our systems are always here at Re~1e-5, but BD does not compute Re; it assumes Re=0, so for a new case with a larger driving speed computing it once is free
